title: int:ContactDetails
description: Contact information record for an Actor. One Actor may have multiple contact records with different contactType values.

contactDetailsId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:contactDetailsId. UUID v4.

actorId.description: FK to owning Actor. IRI: int:actorId. UUID v4.

email.description: Email address. IRI: int:email. RFC 5321 format.

phoneNumber.description: Landline telephone number. IRI: int:phoneNumber. E.164 format.

mobileNumber.description: Mobile phone number. IRI: int:mobileNumber. E.164 format.

contactType.description: Type of contact record. IRI: int:contactType.
